source_reconstruction_scope: PlayerManager::GetHostingPlayer/GetPlayerByInternalID source selection plus the bounded _ManageCharacters property-level comparison, repeated read, and setter dispatch. PlayerInfo construction, manager iteration, network implementation, and application lifecycle remain outside this kernel.

functions.scope: Executed original ARM body for the outer host ID selection. Online/network call targets are explicit harness hooks; the offline ID-zero call and returned PlayerInfo projection are real source instructions.
Executed original ARM -1 fallback and offline ordered-tree lookup branches; network predicates are covered by the native host fixture, not emulated as game services.

Executed the original instruction slice 0x372cf8..0x372d30: property 0x13 read, compare to PlayerInfo+0x330, fresh second read only on mismatch, direct setter argument. The full manager loop is not run.

supporting_evidence.note: The called implementation resolves the fixed property and returns an arithmetic-shifted ordinary signed integer. The ARM caller oracle supplies queued return values at this function boundary, then checks ID=19 and include_bonus=0; no additional shift is applied.

The caller's direct setter dispatch is hooked only to capture the integer argument in this unit's ARM slice test. The setter's actual member/dirty effects are separately executed and validated by reference/character-level-member.

The offline PlayerManager ARM scenarios return a harness-owned object whose +5 byte is zero. The online singleton and CMatching/network objects are explicit provider services in the host tests; they are not claimed as executed original callbacks here.

The constructor invokes PlayerInfo::C1 at this+8, then initializes the local ID-tree header/root. GetPlayerByInternalID returns this+8 for ID -1 or a local-tree miss, so that fallback is a real embedded PlayerInfo in a constructed PlayerManager.

The constructor initializes the int NetStructMember at +0x310 and leaves its value at +0x330 equal to zero. Its conditional branch stores zero and calls SetChanged only if the pre-existing +0x330 word was nonzero; a pre-zeroed embedded member takes the no-dirty branch. This is a member-initializer fact, not a complete PlayerInfo/native manager reconstruction.
PlayerInfo::C1 begins by invoking this base constructor. The +0x330 level member initialization is a subsequent PlayerInfo constructor operation.

limitations: The returned PlayerInfo +0x330 member is represented by an owned stable projection. These files do not construct or register the original PlayerInfo object.
The online/network route preserves exact fresh query and manager reacquisition order at the typed provider boundary; the complete multiplayer singleton/network services are not reconstructed.
The caller slice is not the full _ManageCharacters loop. Its caller-owned player iteration, connectivity, character binding, and unrelated field synchronization remain outside scope.
A port adapter failure is reported as an error; the original source has no corresponding typed failure result or rollback.
